# Prevention owner-runtime terminal-closure research v10 round 2

The round-2 canonical envelope hash is `0ea40d3f4bf80ca4c417f61c0cd7797fecf89df00bd2feac4c95b21dd820505f`; its frozen charter and requirements remain unchanged. The owner policy remains exactly 10 `AVAILABLE`, 6 `CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`, and 9 `UNAVAILABLE`. Availability is not admission: an AVAILABLE owner is executable only after its individually authenticated approved proposal is materialized and all budget, lifecycle, terminal, parent, parameter, root, provider, and receipt gates pass.

## Public material-gap classification

- `MG-O1`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. Current execution accepts caller-supplied UnitBudget values; target execution derives a complete budget from the selected contract and rejects incomplete or insufficient reservation before effects.
- `MG-O2`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. Current recovered STARTED effects always become INDETERMINATE; target dispatches the selected typed owner reconciler to ALREADY_APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED, or INDETERMINATE.
- `MG-O3`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. Current exit zero creates the terminal artifact without owner-semantic verification or owner_terminal event; target verifies exact semantic evidence and records exactly one event/artifact pair.
- `MG-O4`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. `mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry` is the sole child-only owner, but current dispatch does not enforce its parent relation; target requires and atomically consumes a matching active-parent delegation.
- `MG-O5`: `PLANNER_OWNED_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP`. Current adapters use hard-coded parameter/path rules and do not bind proposal schemas, trusted roots, providers, or symlink containment; target validates the materialized schema and all bindings before argv.

## Owner-by-owner current matrix

Each row is authenticated by its current-source evidence item and remains separate from the approved target proposal.

- `local-workflow-orch-image`: budget producer/fields = one harness invocation with source-declared health timeout, port retries, and build retry; identity/observable = Docker image/container/port/copied path/auth/probe state and emitted JSON; terminal = command JSON `ok=true` except logs streams and exits zero; parameters/paths = ten argparse commands and command-specific fields, with caller paths and no materialized trusted-root resolver.
- `greenfield-full-drive`: budget producer/fields = one shell sequence with build, three off-port retries, 30 health polls, auth, restore, and one detached drive start; identity/observable = image/container plus repo/branch/port and durable drive state; terminal = nonzero on failed step, but current success is only `sequence complete` after detached launch; parameters/paths = raw repo/spec/checkpoint/env and drive flags, not a proposal-schema/root binding.
- `mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry`: budget producer/fields = one reentry invocation and one packaged operator action; identity/observable = task/workflow/run request and returned operator envelope; terminal = emitted stage/mode/verdict/finalOk/errorCode, while blocked/error envelopes can still be followed by process zero; parameters/paths = reenter plus three modes and raw repo/prompt/operator fields, with no enforced parent journal.
- `claude-auth-token-refresh`: budget producer/fields = one shell invocation with fail-closed prerequisites and 60-second verify commands; identity/observable = credential state across container, host, vault, and optional remote endpoint; terminal = command-specific human pass/status markers through pass/die; parameters/paths = eight commands with raw token/config/container/vault inputs, not typed secret/resource providers.
- `discovery-promotion-lifecycle`: budget producer/fields = one lifecycle command; drive permits max qualification runs plus six transition iterations; identity/observable = discovery/registered subject, lifecycle state, guarded verification and blocker artifacts; terminal = JSON `ok=true`, with errors JSON and exit 3/5; parameters/paths = four commands with raw file/root/repo-roots and Markdown-derived verification command surfaces.
- `commit-push-main`: budget producer/fields = one publish/resume invocation with no retry; integration runs one fetch/rebase or isolated clone; identity/observable = repo/branch/remote, HEAD/index/worktree/manifest and remote head; terminal = JSON `ok=true` after remote SHA verification, errors exit 2; parameters/paths = flag-composed modes with caller repo/remote/manifest paths and no typed publication receipt binding.
- `discovery-bootstrap`: budget producer/fields = one locked atomic bootstrap invocation; identity/observable = request hash, deterministic bundle/artifact/run IDs and exact existing bytes; terminal = JSON `ok=true` with artifact and run identities, failures emit JSON error; parameters/paths = start plus spec and optional root/repo-roots, current schema validates content but root remains caller-supplied.
- `discovery-candidate-reconciliation`: budget producer/fields = one command; rolling defaults to six attempts and drive performs one guarded rolling run; identity/observable = repository/candidate/registry hashes, manifests, active index and checkpoints; terminal = JSON `ok=true` with command-specific fields, failures exit 3; parameters/paths = five commands with caller root/output/manifest/index/policy/attempt surfaces.
- `convergence-checkpoint-run`: budget producer/fields = one invocation and 30-second default shared-ledger lock acquisition; identity/observable = convergence state, accepted/guarded baseline, ledger/view and child command result; terminal = fixed `CONVERGENCE CHECKPOINT COMMAND OK` plus exit zero; parameters/paths = state/repo/approval/command_json and optional helper/stage/timeout, including arbitrary argv schema v1.
- `convergence-state-review-cycle`: budget producer/fields = one request application, each requested helper operation once, then check and status once; identity/observable = request/state and helper operation results; terminal = JSON status COMPLETE or DRY_RUN based on helper exits; parameters/paths = request v1, optional helper and apply/dry-run, with raw state/helper paths and no per-operation durable receipt.

## Complete greenfield progressive UnitBudget algorithm

The approved target has no fixed whole-workflow duration and no invented aggregate value. Every durable task is classified into exactly one productive or mandatory role/overhead dimension. Every atomic task carries a total of 3,600,000 ms including retry. Before launch, the owner materializes the next task or parallel frontier from durable program state and fully reserves every task vector in that next task/frontier. The workflow aggregate is the component-wise sum of all materialized task vectors. A missing required role, an untyped task, an unresolved next frontier, or insufficient reservation rejects admission or persists a checkpoint before effects; continuation occurs only after a fully typed frontier can be fully reserved. This preserves progressive discovery while making every launched unit complete and pre-admitted.

## Current lifecycle, parent, and binding conclusions

Current checkpoints are PREPARED, STARTED, EXECUTED, TERMINAL. STARTED recovery does not dispatch owner reconcilers, and exit zero directly creates a terminal JSON artifact. The event schema has `effect_reconciled` but no `owner_terminal`, `child_delegation_recorded`, or typed provider/approval receipt event. Only blocker-reentry is child-only, with parents `mawf-playbook-full-test` and `mawf-playbook-speed-test`; both parents remain CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, so the AVAILABLE child remains non-admissible until a parent is executable and active. The other 24 registry rows remain standalone. Static roots come from proposal trusted_roots; local repository resolution is grounded at `work_memory._repo_roots`; remote repository-key resolution is grounded at `build_git_manager_from_settings`; other approved providers require typed controller-owned resolvers and fail closed when unresolved.

All current requirements are answered from accessible, individually hashed implementation sources. All future requirements are grounded by ten individually hashed approved proposals and authority decisions; runtime proof remains NOT_YET_APPLICABLE. Planning must close MG-O1 through MG-O5 without changing 10/6/9 or authorizing deployment, commit, push, credential access, phase-ledger work, or external messages.
